title: Export reports and calibrate comparable work estimates
goal: Save private report snapshots and derive qualified planning samples from the authoritative ledger
acceptance: Add report --out with private permissions, no overwrite/symlink/checkout leakage and no re-import double counting
Show account history and conservative same-window changes; resets, counter decreases, missing data and overlap remain explicit
Provide sample-size/provenance-aware estimation groups for comparable completed work, separating tokens, quota points and currency; no automatic backlog rewriting or quota-to-dollar conversion
privacy: Private counter/allowance metadata only. No prompts, transcripts, credential extraction, account changes or reset-credit consumption.
validation: Owned source-to-ledger/report fixtures and meaningful failure cases
Final required CI and fresh-context independent report-only review
escalation: Material scope expansion or distinct outcome split requires owner agreement
Unknown or shared-source quota usage is not an exact per-task measurement

effort.basis: Existing report/observation contracts are reusable; meaningful allowance attribution needs explicit account/job scope and comparable metadata.
